This enables internal port scanning, service fingerprinting, and access to localhost-only resources without authentication, effectively bypassing network security controls. ### Details **Vulnerable Code:** routers/web/auth/openid.go - SignInOpenID() function **Affected Endpoint:** POST /user/login/openid **Parameter:** openid_url The OpenID authentication handler accepts user-controlled URLs and performs HTTP requests without validation: ``` // routers/web/auth/openid.go func SignInOpenID(ctx *context.Context) { openidURL := ctx.FormString("openid_url") // Vulnerable: No URL validation before HTTP request redirectURL := setting.AppURL + "user/openid/callback" authenticateURL, err := openid.RedirectURL(openidURL, redirectURL, "") // ... } ``` ### PoC - Target: Any Gitea instance with OpenID enabled (default) - Test Instance: http://143.244.141.81:3000 - Navigate to OpenID login page: http://143.244.141.81:3000/user/login/openid - Enter internal service URL in "OpenID URI" field: ``` http://127.0.0.1:22/ (SSH) http://127.0.0.1:3306/ (MySQL) ``` - Click "Sign In" - Check server logs for confirmation ``` journalctl -u gitea -f --no-hostname | grep -E --color "openid|http|dial|error|127\.0\.0\.1" ``` ### Impact - All Gitea instances with OpenID enabled (default configuration) -
